title: The integrated gate runs vitest, so TypeScript behaviour ticks are gated by their tests
description: From yoh final-review finding dfae216d (cs1). The ts gate in .tick/runners.toml runs format, lint, contracts and tsc, but no vitest, so a TS behaviour change merges without its tests running in the gate (mn7's worker ran them; the gate did not). Add the vitest suite to the ts gate once the suite is deterministic under load (3cq and the slot-refused fix were the known flakes); watch its wall time against the gate bound.
